$comment: Platform preference (card xx0055i). fix.standDownHoldsAcrossHeads boolean (standard false; env WE_FIX_STAND_DOWN_HOLDS_ACROSS_HEADS=true|false): false limits terminal stand-downs to their recorded head; legacy unbound comments lapse when the current head was committed after the comment. true preserves the hold across heads. Cascade: env > this file > platform preference > standard, with the source logged. WE_STAND_DOWN_LAPSE_ON_NEW_HEAD remains an inverse on|off compatibility alias. fix.roundCapAction person|takeover: at the fix round cap, takeover = dispatch ONE takeover fix (full round history, top claude rung of the fixer ladder) before asking the operator; person = ask the operator at once (tool override env WE_FIX_ROUND_CAP_ACTION). fix.roundHistory on|off: a round N>1 fix brief carries the previous-rounds section (env WE_FIX_ROUND_HISTORY). fix.takeoverBudget: how many automatic takeovers one PR may get, 0 turns the takeover off, an invalid value fails closed to 0; a further one runs only when the previous one reduced the open findings, else the operator gets a takeover-not-converging note; gate holds (stacked base, review:human hold) never trigger one (cascade: standard 2 -> platform preference scripts/lib/delivery-platform-preferences.json fix.takeoverBudget -> this file -> env WE_FIX_TAKEOVER_BUDGET; see scripts/conveyor/takeover-budget.mjs). Ruling disputes always go to the operator. Card xrbu1bp: fix.resumeAcrossRounds on|off: round N>1 resumes the previous round's fixer session when it is still resumable and its lane is still at the PR head (else a cold start with the history brief; env WE_FIX_RESUME_ACROSS_ROUNDS). fix.strongerModelFromRound: from this round an ordinary fix runs on the fixer ladder's stronger-model rung, 0 = off (env WE_FIX_STRONGER_MODEL_FROM_ROUND). Tool preference 4 gives Codex rounds 1-3 before ordinary escalation, strictly before the standard negotiation round cap of 5; 6 would skip ordinary escalation before that cap. The resolver reports source settings (or env / built-in); the threshold currently uses env > this file > built-in, without a platform layer. Critical-work routing, hard-failure fallback and cross-provider disagreement handling are unchanged. fix.roundExtensionAnchor grant|off (standard grant, env WE_FIX_ROUND_EXTENSION_ANCHOR; cascade env > this file > platform preference > standard): anchor each authenticated round extension to the attempts spent when posted, separately for shared fix/review, conflict and advisory caps; off keeps additive caps. fix.operatorRulingExtraRounds: open operator send-backs also grant this many past-cap fixes, counted by trusted fix-end comments after the latest open request (no grant on truncated threads). For blocked findings, how many directed takeovers one operator ruling (every blocked finding ruled block with a direction) buys past the round cap, standard 1, 0 = off, an invalid value fails closed to 0 (env WE_FIX_OPERATOR_RULING_EXTRA_ROUNDS; set it under this file's fix key like the others); it also needs fix.roundCapAction=takeover and a fix.takeoverBudget above 0, so those two off switches stop it too (see scripts/conveyor/reconcile-core.mjs#resolveOperatorRulingExtraRounds). See scripts/conveyor/fix-takeover.mjs, scripts/conveyor/fix-round-history.mjs and scripts/conveyor/fix-resume.mjs. fix.loopHold.redMainDiscount on|off (default on; env WE_FIX_LOOP_RED_MAIN_DISCOUNT): repair sessions during red-main windows do not consume either loop budget, and parks caused only by those attempts lapse once main recovers. fix.owedCiRerun {rerun: on|off, maxRerunsPerHead: integer >= 0} mechanically re-runs failed required jobs once main is green, standard on with 1 re-run per head (env WE_FIX_OWED_CI_RERUN; cascade env > this file > standard). fix.staleCiRerun off|once-per-head (standard once-per-head; env WE_FIX_STALE_CI_RERUN; cascade env > this file > standard, logged each pass): a red required check not explained by a red main window still gets ONE mechanical re-run of its failed jobs per head while main is green and nothing on the head is still running; off keeps the old path (timeout re-run only, else ci-heal). fix.standDown.gateRedRetries integer 0-3 (standard 1; env WE_FIX_STAND_DOWN_GATE_RED_RETRIES; cascade env > this file > platform preference > standard, logged each pass; live PR #5768): a reason=gate-red stand-down is a failed gate, not a question, so its head earns this many own-failure ci-heals whose brief first checks each failing test against main (pre-existing-on-main reds are pushed as main's, not the PR's); a second gate-red stand-down or a spent retry stays terminal and raises needs-you; 0 turns it off; real-question stand-downs stay terminal.
